title: Original Roadster 2.5 revision
summary: Tesla updates its first-generation sports car. This name is unrelated to the later redesign.

title: Original production run ends
summary: Tesla’s historical filing records roughly 2,500 original Roadsters.

title: Next-generation concept unveiled
summary: A new concept appears at the Semi event; initial production expectation was 2020.

title: Another delivery target
summary: Musk’s reported target shifts to 2025; a forecast, not a delivery.

title: Adaptive-downforce patent publication
summary: Tesla-assigned disclosure becomes public; no Roadster fitment established.

title: Demo timing shifts again
summary: Earnings-call reporting describes a further tentative delay.

title: October 1 teaser
summary: Tesla’s teaser is reported as scheduling an October 1 reveal.

title: Rear-wing patent application indexed
summary: Metadata for a wing application appears; full text needs review.

title: Reveal moves to October 15
summary: Tesla cites forecast weather in the reported rescheduling announcement.

title: Electric fan-car patent indexed
summary: Patent metadata lists Tesla and an electric fan-car disclosure.

title: Redesigned Roadster demonstrated
summary: Prototype event in McGregor, Texas; reporting describes inversion and airborne maneuvers.

title: New configurator checked
summary: Performance and Thrust deposit schedules directly inspected; Rocket invite only.

title: Current production target
summary: Company forecast, not an observed production start or customer delivery.
